an5.60:1.1: “Bhikkhus, it is rare to find one gone forth in old age who possesses five qualities.
an5.60:1.3: It is rare to find one gone forth in old age (1) who is easy to correct; (2) who firmly retains in mind what he has learned; (3) who accepts instruction respectfully; (4) who can speak on the Dhamma; and (5) who is an expert on the discipline.
an5.60:1.4: It is rare to find one gone forth in old age who possesses these five qualities.”
